answer:
Here is what I'd raise, most important first.

1. Your stool test (FIT) on 4 Nov 2025 was POSITIVE, and I can find nothing after it: no colonoscopy, no referral, no repeat. A positive FIT needs a colonoscopy, ideally within a few months, and it is now about a year. This is the main thing to bring up.

2. Diabetes monitoring is due. Your A1c has come down well (8.3% in Jan 2025, 7.6, 7.1, then 6.9% in Feb 2026), but the last one is over 8 months old and these are usually checked every 3-6 months. Kidney tests in Feb 2026 were normal (creatinine 0.88, eGFR 69, though eGFR has drifted down from 73). I see no urine albumin test, eye exam or foot exam in the records.

3. Cholesterol has not been rechecked. Your last lipid panel (Feb 2025) had LDL 131 and total 212, both high. Atorvastatin 20 mg was recorded on 20 Feb 2025, just after, so you should have a repeat panel to see whether it is working.

4. Medicines: you take Jardiance and atorvastatin. Metformin was stopped in April 2024. Ask whether that was intended and confirm your list is right.

5. No vaccines are recorded at all (flu, COVID, pneumonia, shingles, RSV, tetanus). At 69 several are recommended. This may just be missing records, so bring any you have had elsewhere.

6. For reassurance: the July 2025 chest pain visit was worked up with a CT scan showing no pulmonary embolism, and the chest wall pain resolved. The scan noted mild spine wear, which is common. Nothing is needed there.

I also see no records of breast cancer screening (mammogram) or bone density, which may simply be held elsewhere.
short: FIT stool test was positive in Nov 2025 with no colonoscopy on record; A1c (6.9%) and lipids are overdue for recheck; no vaccines recorded.
